card.ability:
This creature has three forms that it switches between on death.
1st: Slime can attack twice per action, and attacks inflict 5T1 Poison and deal 2 piercing CDMG to itself.
2nd: Puppet (Action)(3 points) Deal 7 piercing DMG to itself and another creature on the PF.
3rd: Magician attacks inflict either 2T Frostbite, 2T Burning, or heal any creature by 4 HP.
